lines.text: You are listening to GenWave, the little station run by our friends and neighbors, and we are so glad you are here!
This is GenWave, music all day for our community, and you are the best part of it, so thank you!
Welcome back to GenWave, where the music never stops and the company is always good, so stay right there!
This is GenWave, music for our community, all day and all night.
You are listening to GenWave, the station that belongs to all of us.
GenWave is on the air, with more music on the way, so stay tuned.
You are tuned to GenWave, and we will be here playing music for you all through the night.
This is GenWave, the soft glow in the dark corner of your evening, so settle in and stay a while.
GenWave, music for the late hours, for the people who are still awake, and for anyone who needs the company.
